verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents one-click sync of transactions with reference IDs, timestamps, and on-chain hashes to NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero, plus APIs/webhooks for transaction and expense data that could feed accounting systems. However, this sync claim appears only on the Instant Pay page, not corroborated elsewhere, and OpenAPI/llms.txt probes for deeper API verification 404'd, and there's no independent confirmation of the accounting sync working in practice. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero sync, dedicated accounting-integration documentation beyond a single marketing line, and confirmation the sync is automatic/bidirectional rather than a one-time export.
